text:
Halvorsen Mott has won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge, the Okarra Regional Transport Authority announced on 14 March 2025.

Delphine Arkwright, the Authority's Director of Infrastructure, confirmed the selection. The contract is valued at 218 million credits, and the work is scheduled for completion within 31 months.

The decision follows Tender Evaluation Report OTA-2025/07, published by the Authority's procurement board, which set out the basis on which bids were assessed and the firm selected. The Record has reviewed the report's published findings.

The award formally settles the question of who will carry out the reconstruction. Further details of the construction programme were not part of the announcement, and the Authority has not said when work on site will begin.
